fields.label: Exchange
fields.description: Listing venue (NASDAQ / NYSE / AMEX). Pick one to restrict results to that exchange; leave blank for all US exchanges.

fields.label: Sector
fields.description: GICS sector (one of 11 — Technology, Healthcare, …). Pick one to constrain results to that sector; leave blank to screen across all sectors.

fields.label: Industry
fields.description: GICS industry — narrower than sector (e.g. Semiconductors within Technology). Constrains results to a single industry.

fields.label: Country
fields.description: Country of incorporation (ISO-2 code — US, CA, GB, …). Filters to companies domiciled in that country.

fields.label: Market Cap
fields.description: Total market value of all outstanding shares, in USD. Set min ≥ 300M to exclude small-caps, ≥ 10B for large-caps. Higher min = larger, more liquid companies.

fields.label: Price
fields.description: Latest trade price per share, in USD. Set min ≥ $5 to filter out penny stocks; set max to cap nominal price.

fields.label: Volume (today)
fields.description: Today's traded volume in shares (live). Set min ≥ 1M to keep liquid names. Higher min = tighter spreads, easier fills.

fields.label: Avg Daily Volume (14d)
fields.description: Mean daily share volume over the last 14 completed sessions. Use as a baseline liquidity filter — set min ≥ 500k to exclude thinly-traded names.

fields.label: Relative Volume
fields.description: Today's volume ÷ 14-day ADV. 1.0× = normal, 2.0× = double average. Set min ≥ 2 to surface unusually active stocks (news, catalyst, breakout).

fields.label: Dollar Volume (today)
fields.description: Today's traded value in USD (price × volume). Best single measure of liquidity. Set min ≥ $20M for institutional-tradeable names.

fields.label: Gap %
fields.description: Today's open vs yesterday's close, in percent. Positive = gap up (e.g. +4 = opened 4% higher), negative = gap down. Surfaces overnight catalysts.

fields.label: Day Change %
fields.description: Today's % move vs yesterday's close. Includes the gap and intraday drift. Use to find today's biggest movers.

fields.label: 1-Month Return
fields.description: Price return over the last ~21 trading sessions, in percent. Captures short-term trend.

fields.label: 3-Month Return
fields.description: Price return over the last ~63 trading sessions, in percent. Classic momentum window — set min ≥ 20 for sustained uptrends.

fields.label: 6-Month Return
fields.description: Price return over the last ~126 trading sessions, in percent. Medium-term trend signal.

fields.label: Above 50-day MA
fields.description: Yes = current price > 50-day simple moving average (a short-term uptrend signal). No = below. Any = no filter.

fields.label: Above 200-day MA
fields.description: Yes = current price > 200-day SMA (a long-term bull-trend signal). Combine with Above 50-day MA for a full uptrend.

fields.label: % Below 52-wk High
fields.description: How far the latest price sits below the trailing 52-week high, in percent. 0 = at the high. Set max ≤ 5 to find stocks near breakout.

fields.label: % Above 52-wk Low
fields.description: How far above the trailing 52-week low, in percent. Set max ≤ 10 to find stocks near their lows.

fields.label: Recent positive news
fields.description: Yes = at least one high-materiality positive news item in the last 7 days. Surfaces names with a recent catalyst.

fields.label: Beta
fields.description: Volatility vs the broad market. 1.0 = moves with the market, >1 = more volatile, <1 = less. Set max < 1 for defensive, min > 1.5 for high-beta names.

fields.label: P/E Ratio
fields.description: Price ÷ trailing-twelve-month earnings per share. Lower = cheaper on earnings. Set max ≤ 15 for value, min ≥ 30 for growth-priced names. Negative = unprofitable.

fields.label: EPS
fields.description: Earnings per share over the last 12 months, in USD. Set min > 0 to exclude unprofitable companies.

fields.label: Dividend (annual)
fields.description: Last annual dividend per share, in USD. Set min > 0 to filter for dividend-payers.

fields.label: Short % of Float
fields.description: Percentage of public float sold short. High values (≥ 20%) signal squeeze candidates. Requires a short-interest data source — not yet available.

fields.label: Days to Cover
fields.description: Short interest ÷ average daily volume — how many days for shorts to cover at average volume. Requires a short-interest data source — not yet available.

fields.label: Premarket Volume
fields.description: Shares traded in the premarket session (4:00–9:30 AM ET). Requires a premarket data source — not yet available.

fields.label: Premarket Vol ÷ 14d ADV
fields.description: Premarket volume as a multiple of 14-day ADV. High values (> 0.3) flag pre-open catalysts. Requires a premarket data source — not yet available.
